mcp.title: Connect MCP services
mcp.lead: Packs reference MCP servers that run through the registry gateway. Two connection paths exist — the universal caller-key path and the client-native OAuth discovery path.

keyPath.title: Caller key (universal)
keyPath.body: Mint a wgk- caller key in the registry console; the CLI verifies it and stores it locally (0600). After that, install can write each target's native MCP configuration carrying that key.
keyPath.mintNote: Mint keys in the registry console:

oauthPath.title: OAuth discovery (client-native)
oauthPath.body: The registry answers unauthenticated MCP requests with a WWW-Authenticate header pointing at its protected-resource metadata, and serves the standard discovery documents — clients that support OAuth discovery can complete authorization in the browser.
oauthPath.honest: Whether the connection completes with zero manual entry depends on your client's own OAuth support; dynamic client registration is not offered.

essentials.title: Essentials
essentials.quota: Calls are free within the monthly free quota; over-quota calls are refused with 402 and reset next month.
essentials.tier: Paid-tier servers (e.g. law-bench) refuse community keys with an upgrade prompt naming the tier.
essentials.revoke: Keys can be revoked in the registry console at any time; the local copy can be cleared from the CLI.

create.title: Create and publish a pack
create.lead: Publishing requires the creators group. Three authoring routes exist; all of them end at the same publish gate, and published versions are immutable.
create.route1: In 壹座: Settings → Packs → New pack — compose skills, MCP references, and personas as a draft.
create.route2: One-click conversion: turn a custom preset into a pack draft (Settings → Custom presets → Publish), with a report of what was carried and what needs replacing.
create.route3: From the creator console (#/mine): submit a pack manifest directly to the publish endpoint; validation errors surface verbatim.
create.versions: Every publish appends an immutable version; each version may carry a short note (≤500 characters).
create.subscribe: Subscribe and install are two acts: a subscription is recorded in the market; installing takes a definite version snapshot.
create.gate: Only registry-registered MCP servers can be referenced; agent entries are persona-only.
